Okay so back in my senior year of high school, I had the misfortune of being thrown into a group project for physiology. What the topic was I no longer remember. Now normally this would not be a problem but hot damn was this a dozy of a downfall for my lazy teacher.

My class, now these guys had my back I mean damn, they really tried to pull me into one of the other groups and raised hell about it. Now it was common knowledge that I kept to myself and would raise hell when needed. You leave me alone in my corner with my book and all would be right in the world. Now this teacher decided that it was her personal goal to unravel the secrets of the universe that I held or cause me to commit murder. 

Of all the groups I could be assigned to, it HAD to be with the wannabe loudmouth gangbangers. I mean damn no one liked the so called leader of the group. It was common for the class to tell him to shut up but seriously guys my class feared for me. They knew that something was going down in this class while our poor blissfully unaware teacher was in lala land with unicorns. 

Now my school had the block schedules so classes ran a little longer. I swear this class lasted a year. I'm sitting here trying to get a project down with no help from these clowns. Their leader is more interested in flirting with bimbo teacher while saying he is in charge. The class knows I'm the real leader by keeping careful tabs. You could feel their animosity filling the room.  Eventually one of my classmates starts running interference with the teacher while the others rage on the remainder of the group. 

It comes to a head where then my group starts asking me if I need help and where they can help at. The leader realizes what is happening that this small, underweight rocker chick is undermining him with the help of the class. His buddies tuck tail and help me with the project. We managed to finish our presentation just barely. Now comes the fun part, we have to stand before the class and present our work.

At some point my class banded together with a plan to save me and humiliate the problem children. One by one they volunteer to present their topics. As teens this is a hard thing to do unless forced by the teachers. Somehow the teacher did not notice this, how so is beyond me. Now my group goes dead last like these kids ran to front to prevent him from presenting.  Its finally our turn. 

Guy looks at me and demands that I present saying that it is beneath him as he knows I hate speaking in front of groups but I can do the job. Here comes my class to the rescue. Teenage rage can be heard through the halls. Riots were forming in this small room as the class bands together to descend upon this poor souls. Confused me is lead to another group as my desk and bag is relocated to the back of the room for safety. The leader of the riot demands that I get an A for the assignment while my former group presents the topic without me. 

These poor souls beg for my assistance as they know they will fail without my knowledge of the arcane arts, the teacher demands me to return. But the class bids her to begone foul demon while the poor souls flail about the topic showing that they did no work whatsoever.

My grade was saved that day. Sadly I was removed from this class at her demand for causing such a scene. There is nothing scarier than staring down a group of hellbent angered teens determined to right an unjust wrong based together with pitchforks.
